facts.business: Hindustan Motors Limited is an Indian automotive company that historically manufactured vehicles at its Uttarpara factory, but the Government of West Bengal resumed and took possession of the factory land during the year, leading to a write-off of the property.

auditor.name: KAMG & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Auditors expressed a qualified opinion on the financial statements for the year ended 31.03.2026; Government of West Bengal resumed and took possession of Uttarpara factory land during the year and the Company wrote off the said property; property, plant and equipment not physically verified during the year; delays in depositing statutory dues including sales tax/VAT and municipal tax; disputed dues of Central Excise Act amounting to Rs 3,827.09 lakh pending at various forums; West Bengal Deferment Tax of Rs 1,791.50 lakh outstanding for more than six months and not paid.

key_risks: Government of West Bengal resumed and took possession of factory land at Uttarpara
Property, plant and equipment not physically verified during the year
Delays in depositing statutory dues including sales tax/VAT and municipal tax
Significant disputed tax dues pending at various forums (Central Excise: Rs 3,827.09 lakh; West Bengal Deferment Tax: Rs 1,791.50 lakh)
No operational profit leading to no dividend recommendation
Voluntary delisting from NSE completed in October 2025
No inventory and no working capital limits sanctioned from banks/financial institutions
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not provided any loans and advances to any firms/companies in which Directors are interested.
